{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = he's really over-committed to this Big Balls thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:04.246
    | text      = (laughs) When I was preparing the episode, I thought it would be funny to go through Jefferson's letters
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:08.266
    | text      = and find one where he was bestowing an honor on someone, and then I would replace whatever title he said
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:13.086
    | text      = with "The Big Balls Award."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.547
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.887

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:17.586
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:18.186
    | text      = However, when I was going through some of Jefferson's letters, I came across one from 1811-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:22.847
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:23.027
    | text      = ... written to a guy named Peter Miner, and I couldn't believe how much this made me think of Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:27.867
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:28.266
    | text      = So,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:29.686
    | text      = this guy, Pete, he'd written to Jefferson suggesting that they impose a tax on dog
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:34.327
    | text      = ownership-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:34.967
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:35.027
    | text      = ... 'cause he didn't like them and he thought that they were killing sheep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:37.706
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:38.067
    | text      = He hoped that the tax would encourage people to, uh, if they owned dogs, that they would kill them, so they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:42.666
    | text      = wouldn't have to pay this tax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:43.927
    | text      = Wow!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:44.507
    | text      = Yeah. So, Jefferson wrote him back, and I assure you, I am not making this up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:49.467
    | text      = Quote, "Dear Sir, I participate in all your hostility to dogs and would readily join
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:54.347
    | text      = in any plan for exterminating the whole race."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:57.527
    | text      = Well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:57.967
    | text      = Did you know that? (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:59.726
    | text      = I mean-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:59.967
    | text      = That Thomas Jefferson and Alex share a passion for killing dogs?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:02.706
    | text      = It makes as much sense as anything else to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:04.907
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:05.606
    | text      = That's something that I, I don't feel like I was taught in school-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:08.266
    | text      = I-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:08.306
    | text      = ... is that Jefferson had a, had a hunger for the blood of dogs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:11.487
    | text      = You know, the more you read about presidents, the more you feel like maybe we don't know about a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:16.467
    | text      = lot of this stuff on purpose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:17.907
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:18.286
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:18.806

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
